messages:
anya: FYI noisy rejects from the fncall strict rollout in prod-eu. pattern: model emits `null` for `metadata.author` and strict validator treats missing vs null differently -> reject_count spike. sample log: ```fncall_reject reason=invalid_type field=metadata.author expected=string actual=null route=ingest-v1 variant=canary123```

michael: so this is a type vs presence nuance. gateway used to coerce `null`->"" in permissive mode. strict canary prevents coercion. are these being billed as failed requests?

frank: currently rejects increment the route's request_count and also the billing_meter. that's causing a cost spike on ingest-v1 while canary is live. imo rejects for strict-canary should be tagged differently (e.g., `billing_tag=canary_reject`) so finance can filter.

zara: console team: we got lots of complainants about alert noise (alerts for each reject). can we rollup rejects into one alert with top-5 sample payloads + trending sparkline? also surface which policy (canary/strict) caused them.

anya: agreed on both. telemetry gap: logs include `variant` but not `policy_mode` or `validation_cause`. proposal: add `validation_cause` (enum: type_mismatch|missing_required|schema_violation), `policy_mode` (permissive|soft|strict), and `policy_id` (short id). small strings, indexed.

michael: ingest team worried about cardinality. adding 3 string fields increases ES cardinality. we should sample rejects to 5% and index full fields only on sampled events, while still emitting lightweight counters for all rejects. counters carry `policy_mode` minimal enum though.

frank: for billing: emit a metric `rejects.by.billing_slice` with labels (route, billing_slice) where billing_slice defaults to route but for canary => `canary`. That way dashboards show true cost by slice. plus a reconciliation job when canary promotes to merge costs.

zara: UX: heatmap + incident card. heatmap rows=route, cols=policy_mode, cell shows reject_rate delta vs baseline. clicking cell opens 'samples' pane with sanitized example(s) and a link: `Open rollout rl/2025-11-10` if audit present. Also add quick action: `toggle policy soft-mode` which triggers a rollback checklist.

ops-bot: deploy: rollout rl/2025-11-10 started @2025-11-10T09:12:03Z by @jen. policy=strict

anya: quick mitigation: set sampling of detailed reject docs to 5% and create a short-term alert aggregation rule: group by route+validation_cause+policy_mode with a 10m window, threshold 50 -> single alert. ops accepted.

michael: will that hide important spikes? set aggregation rule to include top sample payloads and top model variant so triage still has context.

frank: i'll own billing_tagging change + metrics emit. will add `billing_slice` label and update cost ETL to treat `canary` specially. also create a nightly job to re-attribute canary_billed_costs when rl promotes.

zara: i'll mock heatmap and incident card by EOW. include sample viewer with redaction rules and a CTA to open the rollout.

anya: telemetry PR owners? need someone to add `validation_cause/policy_mode/policy_id` to reject payload schema and sampling flag.

michael: i'll take PR for gateway side. i'll add sampling logic (5% full docs) + low-cardinality counter stream for dashboards.

ops-bot: created alert-rule #512: "fncall-strict-reject-aggregate" grouping_window=10m threshold=50

frank: perf note: counters should be emitted as fast metrics; avoid heavy ES writes for unsampled rejects. recommend using our metrics pipeline (prometheus -> long-term TSDB) for rates and only push sampled docs to ES for search.

zara: important: console must show whether rejects affected billing; add a small badge next to route: `⚠️ billing-impact (canary)` when billing_slice!=route.

anya: final follow-ups: (1) michael PR for telemetry + sampling (2) frank PR for billing_slice metric + ETL job (3) zara heatmap mock + rollback CTA (4) ops: enable alert-rule #512. track in rl/2025-11-10. thanks all :white_check_mark:
